description: How large one uploaded file may be in this company: 'effectiveMegabytes' is what every upload is held to — an issue's or a wiki page's file, a chat's, a pasted picture, add_attachment and add_wiki_attachment, pm-files. 'megabytes' is the company's own choice, null for the platform's ('platformMegabytes', the most it can be). 'mayChange' says whether you may change it — the company's administrators, with set_file_size_limit.
name: get_file_size_limit
title: Get file size limit
